scope: Twelve-world structural/composition/coherent-density and scoped real-shadow candidate in the actual main SkyPulse scene and UI at750x1334. Approved Neon Finch3D workshop model uses the Editor-only in-game visual preview; static flight pose t=.25; Neon City and Aurora Rise motion pose frame/30. Three complete districts replace the clipped foreground clone; every world arrives at nonzero route distance. Home uses the actual current Home renderer. All twelve worlds remain local visual review candidates.
proof: Camera.Render GPU readbacks; normal collision-checked flight simulation; actual palette/world bindings, coherent-density resource, isolated shadow flags and temporary range restoration, real shadow on/off GPU comparison, partial-world crossfade captures and reduced-motion pixel identity.
limits: Editor rendering is not physical-device visual acceptance, thermal profiling or device FPS. Fixtures select worlds directly; these are not a single uninterrupted scored run. Earlier comparison used the Chrome Raven sprite and a different pose, so this is not a controlled shader-only A/B comparison. The preview does not establish physical-device behavior or approval of the other fourteen roster studies.
